title: High Propagule Pressure and Patchy Biotic Resistance Control the Local Invasion Process of the Tree Ligustrum lucidum in a Subtropical Forest of Uruguay
content: The tree Ligustrum lucidum (W. T. Aiton, Oleaceae), native to East Asia (China), has become an aggressive invader of subtropical and temperate forests around the world. To under-stand how its local small-scale spread is controlled, we studied in a subtropical forest of Uruguay the distribution of seedlings, saplings and poles in relation to distance to mother trees and forest stand (48 plots of 4 m-2).
